skill_name: What are some challenges with distributed data storage?
workflow: Some of the challenges associated with distributed data storage include data consistency, data integrity, data availability, data security, network latency, and system complexity. Data consistency is a challenge in distributed data storage because it requires all nodes in the distributed system to have access to the same data.
